Research limitation: Dataset contains the first 1,000 available records from each month in 2025, not a representative probability sample. Monthly counts are fixed by design and hourly patterns are affected by earliest-first extraction. Administrative closure does not necessarily mean a real-world problem was solved. Do not infer citywide prevalence, true seasonal demand or agency quality from this sample.
